insights.title: High Frequency of Budget Management Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 14 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of multiple calls to this endpoint and consider implementing caching or batching.

insights.title: UI Actions Trigger API Calls
insights.description: User actions in the UI, such as logging in and generating reports, consistently trigger corresponding API calls.
insights.recommendation: Document the UI-API interactions to ensure alignment between frontend actions and backend processes.

executiveSummary: • All tests executed successfully with no failed endpoints recorded.
• The highest latency observed was 2,259 ms during report generation, indicating potential performance concerns.
• The POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml endpoint was called 14 times in one test, suggesting inefficiencies.
• User authentication processes were consistently triggered across all workflows, highlighting their importance.
• The observed patterns may indicate opportunities for optimization in API call frequency and response times.
• Further analysis of the high-frequency calls could lead to improved performance and user experience.
• Documenting UI-API relationships can enhance understanding of system interactions and support future development.
